rule: Every generated Dreamiez or Kelp Atlantis avatar asset targets both ecosystems by default.
asset_rules: Every asset receives a unique SKU ID.
Every asset receives a stable canonical asset ID shared across both ecosystems.
Dreamiez-only shared avatar generation is prohibited.
Kelp Atlantis-only shared avatar generation is prohibited.
A wearable game asset gets a browser avatar representation when technically applicable.
A browser wearable gets a game representation when technically applicable.
Gauntlet PASS is required before mass-consumption listing.
Approval is required before public release or paid checkout.
